name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceLiveVideoV2Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the second-generation live-video experience. It plays the live promotion and tracks whether the viewing requirement is met.
disableEffect: This live-video ad task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.
